_comment: Per-config training speed on Kaggle T4 (fp32, train.py defaults B=8 T=256), used by queue.py to pack sessions. 'measured' values come from results/kaggle/gputest_t4x2 (kernel parthgarg101/abr-gputest-t4x2 v1, commit 3d051a8, two runs in parallel on T4 x2, steps 100-300 of the real 60k schedule, cheap evals every 50 steps). 'estimated' values use step_ms = 30 ms (embedding + 50k-vocab head + optimizer) + 10.1 ms per attention layer + 5.9 ms per Mamba-1 layer, fitted to Transformer 6L and Mamba 13L, or copy the ABR-4L-CBSC layout for routing baselines. Update after the first real session.

ABR-4L-gatedCBSC.source: measured (Mamba-2 Triton path; 4.8 min JIT before step 1)

ABR-2L-CBSC.source: estimated, half of ABR-4L's per-layer cost

ABR-2L-noCBSC.source: estimated, half of ABR-4L's per-layer cost
